info.title: EMCORE MCP Gateway API
info.description:
Machine & Copilot Protocol (MCP) tool integration gateway, exposing governed AI agent tools, semantic discovery capabilities, automated workflow inspection, and standardized schema prompts for external AI clients.

**Service Ownership:** AI Integration & MCP Team
**Intended Consumers:** AI copilots, autonomous LLM agents, automated developer toolchains
**Operational Mode:** Primarily synchronous HTTP API; critical domain mutations emit versioned outbox events and may operate under eventual consistency.
**Confidentiality:** Public/Enterprise Consumer Contract.

get.description: Returns HTTP 200 OK without evaluating downstream network or storage dependencies to confirm that the container process is actively running without deadlocks. Excludes rate limiting.
Evaluates real-time connectivity to core runtime infrastructure (databases, caches, event brokers). Returns 200 OK when service is fully initialized and ready to safely handle consumer traffic.

Returns executable release metadata including service logical identifier, semantic version string, and runtime environment designation. Used for contract compatibility validation and diagnostic tracing.

parameters.name: X-Request-Id
parameters.description: Unique per-request tracing identifier (ULID or UUID). Max length 64 chars. Propagated through middleware to backend logs.

parameters.name: X-Correlation-Id
parameters.description: Distributed transaction correlation identifier across multiple services. Preserved across outbox domain events and message boundaries.

parameters.name: X-Client-Version
parameters.description: Calling consumer version string for diagnostics and feature deprecation telemetry.

parameters.name: Accept-Language
parameters.description: Preferred locale for user-facing validation and problem details messaging (e.g., en-AE, ar-AE).

500.description: Internal Server Error (unhandled exception without Problem Details schema formatting)

type.description: URI reference identifying the problem type.

title.description: Short human-readable summary of the error.

detail.description: Detailed diagnostic explanation of the error condition.
detail.example: One or more request parameters failed structural validation.

EmcoreProblemDetails.description: RFC 7807 standardized problem details error payload.

Bearer.description: PRODUCTION GATEWAY JWT VALIDATION: NOT IMPLEMENTED. PRODUCTION FALLBACK TO TEST AUTH: PROHIBITED. DEVELOPMENT ONLY token verification. DEFERRED.

ClientCredentials.description: OAuth-style client credentials for service identities. Requires Client ID and Secret to obtain a short-lived bearer token from POST /api/v1/auth/token.

StepUpToken.description: High-entropy step-up token issued upon high-assurance identity challenge completion (MFA/biometrics). Required for sensitive administrative modifications and elevated security operations. Valid for 5 minutes; cannot be refreshed without re-authentication.
StepUpToken.name: X-StepUp-Token
